question: How many customers are in each state?
sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY state

question: What was total revenue from paid orders in September 2026?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.qty * p.price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'

question: Which 5 products sold the most units in paid orders?
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.qty) AS units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units DESC, p.name LIMIT 5

question: How many orders were refunded?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'refunded'

question: Which customers placed more than 10 orders?
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

question: What is the average value of a paid order?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(t), 2) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.qty * p.price) AS t FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY o.order_id)

question: What is the paid revenue for each product category?
sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.qty * p.price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.category

question: Which customers have never placed an order?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL
